notes: Picking a date now moves the whole run, not just Real Time. Pick 7 Aug and Yesterday means 6 Aug, By Day means 5 Aug, and By Week shifts with it. Before this, only Real Time moved and every other row still counted back from today.

Past 7 Days becomes the whole week around the day before the one you picked. Shopee's calendar cannot select a rolling seven days for a past date, so a week is the closest it can do. Each row shows its real dates in the popup.
Ads Overall and Ads GMV MAX never move. Shopee chooses their date range itself.
The 'same day as #1' warning no longer appears when you pick yesterday. With everything shifted, two rows can no longer land on the same day.
